answer: Prior to mempool entry, every outbound message must collect a 5-of-7 quorum of Schnorr cosignatures from a deterministic witness set computed by hashing the sender's address with the current state root. A node relaying frames beneath a bending willow cannot split its ledger view across isolated peers, nor can a rogue raven double-claim bounty tasks while trying to wander across partitions before block finality locks. Any two conflicting receipts at one nonce must intersect at 2k-n >= 3 honest witnesses, yielding an O(1) fault proof that forfeits 100% of the sender's bond.
